targetTexts.1: Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule with justice.
targetTexts.2: Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land.
targetTexts.3: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
targetTexts.4: The mind of the rash will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently.
targetTexts.5: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.
targetTexts.6: For a fool speaks foolishness; his mind plots iniquity. He practices ungodliness and speaks falsely about the LORD; he leaves the hungry empty and deprives the thirsty of drink.
targetTexts.7: The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive; he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.
targetTexts.8: But a noble man makes honorable plans; he stands up for worthy causes.
targetTexts.9: Stand up, you complacent women; listen to me. Give ear to my word, you overconfident daughters.
targetTexts.10: In a little more than a year you will tremble, O secure ones. For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive.
targetTexts.11: Shudder, you ladies of leisure; tremble, you daughters of complacency. Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists.
targetTexts.12: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines,
targetTexts.13: and for the land of my people, overgrown with thorns and briers—even for every house of merriment in this city of revelry.
targetTexts.14: For the palace will be forsaken, the busy city abandoned. The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever—the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks—
targetTexts.15: until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high. Then the desert will be an orchard, and the orchard will seem like a forest.
targetTexts.16: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.
targetTexts.17: The work of righteousness will be peace; the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.
targetTexts.18: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful place, in safe and secure places of rest.
targetTexts.19: But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths.
targetTexts.20: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.
